```c
MI_SEMAPHORE_TARGET(waiter->id);
```
```c

```
```c

```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the semaphore signaling mechanism incorrectly uses the engine identifier (`id`) instead of the hardware identifier (`hw_id`). This mismatch can lead to the wrong engine being targeted when signaling semaphores, causing potential synchronization issues between the software and hardware.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
MI_SEMAPHORE_TARGET(waiter->hw_id);
```
```c
engine->hw_id = 0; // and similar lines for other engines
```
Reason:
The fix involves changing the semaphore signaling to use the correct hardware identifier (`hw_id`) instead of the engine identifier (`id`). This ensures that the signaling mechanism correctly targets the intended hardware engine, thus resolving the synchronization issues that arose from the previous incorrect implementation.
